title: focuser_primaluce calibration held the device queue during its waits
summary: START slept between its steps and waited up to 10 s for a SESTO SENSO 3 restart, and END polled the new range for up to 5 s, all inside the X_CALIBRATE handler. Requests queued meanwhile, an abort included, ran only after the wait, against the handler + finalizer rule. Listed as a 3.0.0.27 limitation in REFACTOR.md; the owner asked for the fix.
evidence: 012-primaluce-calibration-finalizers/verification.md (FND-000060); 3.0.0.27 driver fails sestosenso3_calibration, sestosenso3_calibration_restart and sestosenso3_abort_during_restart

resolution.evidence: 012-primaluce-calibration-finalizers/verification.md: the waits are focuser_calibration_start/restart/end finalizers; the three cases pass and fail against the previous driver; recorded run and supervised hardware check.
